title: Review Report Verdict
description: The report-LEVEL verdict a reviewer computes and the orchestrator gates the fix loop on. Distinct from a per-finding ruling (see finding-verdict.schema.json). Computed mechanically from the unresolved finding set (review-report-standards Verdict Arithmetic): any CRITICAL/HIGH present -> CHANGES_REQUIRED; only MEDIUM/LOW -> APPROVED_WITH_FOLLOWUPS; nothing unresolved -> APPROVED. Value domain only; the arithmetic SEMANTICS live in review-report-standards.
